summary: Regentis Biomaterials Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of ordinary shares and warrants. On June 17, 2026, the company entered into securities purchase agreements with accredited and institutional investors to sell 1,844,543 ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants for 12,600 shares, plus ordinary warrants for 1,857,143 shares, at $3.50 per unit (or $3.4999 for pre-funded units). Gross proceeds are ~$6.5 million, with expected close on June 23, 2026. The pre-funded warrants have a $0.0001 exercise price; the ordinary warrants have a $4.20 exercise price, five-year term, and a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker (up to 9.99% on notice). The company agreed to register resale shares within 15 trading days post-closing, with liquidated damages for delays. Net proceeds will fund clinical trials, regulatory submissions, manufacturing scale-up, European market entry, and working capital.
